attack.finding: Support legs snap from an asymmetric whole-body gait pose to the old symmetric Walk00 attack endpoint, then to Attack01/04 and back. The visible eye ring remains at the same apparent size and center. Actor scale stays [1,1,1], rotation stays effectively constant.
attack.notEstablished: The changing renderer bounds alone do not establish a whole-body scale or pivot bug: bounds necessarily change with leg reach. Core similarity is a visual observation, not a reconstructed 3D measurement.
attack.targetedRecommendation: Bake a continuous whole-body attack from the same 05 limb parts, with short entry/return bridges indexed by captured gait phase. First bridge frame must equal the selected incoming whole-body pose; final return must match that gait phase. Preserve melee timings and root lunge movement. Keep runtime work to sprite lookup via a species override.
attack.avoid: RGBA crossfade of mismatched leg silhouettes creates duplicate spikes. Resetting the gait to phase zero only moves the visible snap to a different transition. Do not remove intentional attack reach to conceal this mismatch.

death.visualFinding: Detached legs disappear while the central ring/body stays in place. This resembles the authored transfer of detached anatomy into independently moving Gore fragments, rather than a uniform scale reduction.
death.runtimeFinding: EnemyDeathEffects2D listens to EnemyHealth2D.Died and calls GoreBurst2D.Play once. RemainsRecord2D releases independent pieces after GoreProfile.releaseDelay=0.12. ALL current fresh-death Stalker variants (restorationOnly=0: hollow/retained/split-core eye03/flesh03) have replaceOriginalBody=1. The radial/heavy-close/scattered variants with replaceOriginalBody=0 are restorationOnly=1 and cannot be selected by a fresh Kill. Therefore the old renderer should already be hidden at .12s, before Death02в†’Death03 at .5s. Sleeper fresh-death variants likewise replace it.
death.beforeLimitation: The historical before diagnostic silently restored Dead, so it did not trigger procedural Gore. Its 64% foreground drop is insufficient to call the live death effect defective.
death.requiredLiveCheck: Repeat GoreFinalProbe after the view-only last-live-frame hold correction and final assets: exact previous live sprite until Gore hides original body, two attempted Kill calls still one Died/one remains. Preserve native .12s release and rupture.

actualGoreBaseline.foldedDefect: Waiting/fullfold and Sleeping switch to extended legacy Death00 on samples0-7 before the intended body replacement at sample8. This is an unintended pre-rupture pose jump, distinct from intentional native Gore fragmentation.
actualGoreBaseline.framingLimitation: Distant flying blood clips some 2.8-ortho baseline captures. Final death camera is 4.5; no actor-body clipping established.
